clips.title: The story
paras: Forced Disarmament is an Alliance quest in the Wetlands tasking adventurers with seizing weapon caches from the Dragonmaw clan at Dragonmaw Retreat. By collecting thirty bundles of armaments, players prevent the hostile orcs from equipping additional soldiers for future raids. The confiscated gear is delivered to Captain Stoutfist at Menethil Keep to safeguard the region's vital harbor.

In the marshlands of the Wetlands, the hostile Dragonmaw clan has begun gathering an alarming stockpile of weapons within the Dragonmaw Retreat. Left unchecked, these supplies would allow the renegade orcs to equip fresh waves of warriors and launch devastating raids against neighboring settlements. Disarming their encampments strikes directly at their logistical capability, blunting any planned offensive before their warbands can fully mobilize and take the field.

Menethil Harbor serves as the primary gateway connecting Khaz Modan and Stormwind to the sea, making any nearby military build-up a severe peril. Captain Stoutfist coordinates defensive measures from Menethil Keep, keeping vigilant watch over the hostile clans and beasts encroaching upon the town. Recovering thirty sets of Dragonmaw armaments deprives the orcs of essential munitions while providing the dwarven garrison with vital intelligence regarding the enemy's readiness.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Dragonmaw are stockpiling all manner of weaponry. It would be wise to relieve them of these before more soldiers can be armed.
Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep would surely be interested in these.
